title: TailnetCertVerifier duplicated in kith-peer and kithd — can drift silently
description: kith-peer/src/lib.rs and kithd/src/discovery.rs each define an independent TailnetCertVerifier struct with identical contract. peer_fetch.rs avoids a third copy by importing discovery::TailnetCertVerifier, but the kith-peer copy is fully separate with no compile-time coupling. Suggested rewrite: move TailnetCertVerifier into kith-core (or add a minimal kith-tls helper crate) so both consumers import the same type. If the crate boundary is a blocker short-term, add a // SYNC: see kithd::discovery::TailnetCertVerifier comment and a doc test that exercises both.
